failures.evidence: packages/envoy/internal/broker/api/handlers_launcher.go:68-71 at 0accff8e (added in 6df6138d) calls giveBackAddress() when VerifyServiceToken's error is written as a 500. Today no verify error reaches 500: machine/token.go:63-85 maps every VerifyAccount error to ErrTokenExpired or ErrTokenInvalid (401), so the path is dead. But it is the path the address bucket guards (a token that does not verify makes the verifier refetch the issuer's keys): a later change answering a key-fetch failure 500 would refund every forged-token attempt. Required fix: delete that give-back, so only the give-backs after a successful verification (handlers_launcher.go:80-84) stay; add a test with the database closed, tokens signed by an unknown key and PerAddress burst 2, expecting 401, 401, 429. No red test is committed for it: with every verify error mapped to 4xx, no test can fail on today's code.
